families.fixedBy: Add required control-owner edges to the canonical graph consumed by both evaluators.
families.reduction: Attempted single-instance reductions with constant selected coordinates, or a shared Fail condition, did not activate. The retained reduction uses two contexts, origin-dependent coordinates, and distinct value/statement conditions.

families.firstDefectiveProducer: src/geometry/evaluate.ts: geometry-value expression evaluation omits collection lookup callbacks
families.fixedBy: Reuse the existing complete typed-expression context for geometry values.
families.reduction: A root one-member number array, one indexed coordinate value, and one drawable consumer suffice; Module and conditional collection syntax are unnecessary.

families.firstDefectiveProducer: packages/nui-language/src/dsl/dslDocument.ts: Module event order is not supplied to binding-version lowering for poisoned declarations with no executable initializer
families.fixedBy: Pass the existing moduleScalarRuntime per-binding event positions; retain Rust strict source-order validation.
families.reduction: One disabled one-parameter Module and three following scalar bindings cause catalog rank to collide with source order. Enabling the Module or removing the third binding removes the rejection.

followOns.firstDefectiveProducer: TS and Rust Module completion postpone the failure fact until pending private alias programs finish, permitting an external consumer to observe a partial result.
followOns.fixedBy: Publish the existing failed-instance fact immediately after a completed body failure; retain ordinary value completion and atomic cleanup.
followOns.classification: Required repair follow-on, zero additional baseline families.
followOns.contamination: E-A/B/C-01 T observed after producer repairs; do not count as a new baseline discovery.
